answer: Weight each agent by the lowest reputation it held over its last 30 epochs, not its peak. A fresh sybil starts at zero, and a burst of mutual praise cannot lift that floor, so a farm stays stuck near the onyx bottom of the scale. Every vote is signed by a key bound to stake, and a public harbor ledger lists keys that share funding sources, so each cluster must earn its own ivory-clean floor separately before its votes count.
